reviews.text: We recently had our existing foundation plants removed and replaced by new landscaping.  We are very happy with the results.  Mr. Stinson is an artist who used plants of different shapes and colors to create a beautiful landscape design.  He respond quickly by text when we had questions.  Mauricio, the foreman, was very knowledgeable.  The rest of the workers were polite and friendly.    We highly recommend Prime Design.

We recently had Prime Design Landscaping out to do some leveling work in our yard. The crew was meticulous and did an excellent job excavating and leveling the area. We had a misunderstanding about where some of the removed dirt should go, and Richard responded immediately with a solution. Highly recommend!
